correctness.rationale: RESULT.md blob 9431142f3bc3d5091e18597a8642e00a44655e44: a coherent orientation of the 2^d sign-choice facets gives the exact full-dimensional signed volume d!vol(P)=|det C| for C=[p_i^+-p_i^-], independent of central symmetry or origin position. Expanding 2d squared vertex deviations yields D=4d-2 max_R tr(R^T C)=4d-2 sum_i s_i by orthogonal Procrustes. Applying AM-GM to the positive singular values produces the sharp global envelope and equal-singular-value characterization. To prove actual polytope realizability, p_i^±=±r e_i+t e_{i+1} with t=sqrt(1-r²), 2t<r; every sign-choice facet is strictly exposed by the unique solution of u_i=1-(t/r) eps_{i+1}u_{i+1}, and each opposite point lies strictly inside the supporting halfspace; positive barycentric weights place origin inside. Thus equality continuum r in (2/sqrt5,1], D=4d(1-r), yields the exact local coefficient 2^d/(4d!). Independent exact rational verification checked all supporting sign facets for d=2..5 and r=12/13,t=5/13, including cyclic d=2; does not substitute for uniform contraction proof.
residual_risks: Requires cross-polytope combinatorial type, nonadjacent pairing and all 2d vertices on the sphere; not an inequality for arbitrary 2d-vertex polytopes.
